mapper.select: SELECT N.NOTICE_NO noticeNo , M.MEMBER_ID noticeWriter , N.NOTICE_TITLE noticeTitle , N.ENROLL_DATE createDate , N.VIEW_COUNT viewCount , N.STATUS status , N.FIX fix FROM CL_NOTICE N JOIN CL_MEMBER M ON (N.MEMBER_NO = M.MEMBER_NO) ORDER BY NOTICE_NO DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CL_NOTICE_ATTACHMENT VALUES ( SEQ_NOTICE_FILE_NO.NEXTVAL, #{refBno}, #{originName}, #{changeName}, #{filePath}, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT NOTICE_TITLE noticeTitle , NOTICE_CONTENT noticeContent , VIEW_COUNT viewCount , ENROLL_DATE createDate FROM CL_NOTICE WHERE NOTICE_NO = #{noticeNo}
mapper.update: UPDATE CL_NOTICE SET STATUS = 'N' WHERE NOTICE_NO = #{noticeNo}
mapper.select: SELECT FILE_NO fileNo , ORIGIN_NAME originName , CHANGE_NAME changeName , FILE_PATH filePath , UPLOAD_DATE uploadDate FROM CL_NOTICE_ATTACHMENT WHERE REF_BNO = #{noticeNo}
